provenance.purpose: Prospective fixed-policy architecture screen after professor/co-worker feedback; four arms, two fresh paired seeds, L4 conditioned-g development groups only.
provenance.baseline: Fresh original 37922-parameter circular CNN receives the SAME longer budget as every new arm. Prior frozen 500-epoch results remain intact.
provenance.architectures: Baseline; same convolutions plus BatchNorm; same convolutions plus 8-group GroupNorm; exact same convolutions plus parameter-free residual skip. Conv biases are retained across all arms.
provenance.selection: Rank by mean own-view validation MSE over both seeds only after all 8 models finish. D5 and crossed f/g/exact inputs are secondary, not selection criteria.
provenance.limits: Screening is not fresh confirmation, optimal tuning, full convergence or an estimator interaction test. GroupNorm uses global spatial statistics. Known-field simulation targets magnitudes only; D5 uses reference signs.
provenance.next: Review all arms including failures/caps; freeze shortlist and final multi-seed/size/f-g/untouched-H protocol before confirmation. Raw-snapshot set-CNN remains separate planned work. Long runs are user launched.
